_comment: Builds the distributable Windows installer. Every path and command line is data here so a bundler change does not become a Python change.
platform_refusal: The installer is an NSIS .exe for Windows 10/11. The product's build scope was narrowed to Windows by owner decision 2026-07-26 (docs/decisions/open-questions.md); macOS/Linux bundling is deferred with cross-platform support.

steps.label: build the frontend, the release binary, and the NSIS installer

_artifact_note: cargo xtask package prints this too; the script re-reads the directory so it reports what is actually on disk rather than what the build claimed.
